from_version.heading: 4.2 Error Codes
from_version.body_text: The CT-200 provides deterministic error code diagnostics in Table 4.1. If an overpressure condition (> 299 mmHg) occurs, the device immediately initiates automatic cuff deflation within 2.0 seconds and logs error E3.

to_version.heading: 4.2 Error Codes
to_version.body_text: The CT-200 provides deterministic error code diagnostics in Table 4.1. If an overpressure condition (> 299 mmHg) occurs, the device immediately initiates automatic cuff deflation within 1.5 seconds and logs error E3. Error code E6 indicates Bluetooth synchronization failure.
